title: voxelFEM: a matrix-free GPU finite-element solver for elasticity on voxel grids
description:
voxelFEM is a finite-element solver for linear and nonlinear elasticity on voxel grids, written in Python with CuPy and run on one CUDA GPU. Every voxel is one trilinear hexahedral element, so a segmented CT scan or another 3-D image is simulated without meshing. The solver assembles no stiffness matrix and stores no element connectivity. It uses a Newton-Raphson iteration with load stepping, a preconditioned conjugate gradient method, and a Jacobi or a geometric multigrid preconditioner.

Scripts map CT grey levels to a Young's modulus field, compute the effective modulus of a scan, and generate deformed images from the computed displacement field. A small sample CT volume of a glass-fibre reinforced polyamide is included.
